meta.title: Synapse Academy — Don't just use AI. Build it.
meta.description: A rigorous, build-first AI engineering school: from the mathematics of neural networks to autonomous agents in production. Become the engineer who builds AI, not just the one who uses it.

home.title: Don't just use AI. Build it.
home.subtitle: The people who shape AI don't stop at prompts — they understand it down to the mathematics and build it with their own hands. This is the path from first principles to production systems: the deep, durable skill that makes an engineer impossible to replace.
home.whySubtitle: Not another passive course you forget in a week — a build-first path that turns you into an engineer who can make AI from nothing.
home.why1Title: Build it, don't just use it
home.why1Body: Anyone can call an API. Here you derive the math and implement it by hand — so you become the person who builds AI, not just the one who uses it.
home.why2Body: Models and tools change every month. The understanding you build from the ground up does not — it is the skill that stays valuable for your whole career.
home.why3Title: All the way to the frontier
home.why3Body: Train an LLM from scratch, then build agents, tools and MCP servers — the exact skills the industry is desperate for right now.
home.why4Body: Every lesson ships a real artifact — a prompt, skill, agent or MCP server. You finish with a portfolio that proves you can build, not a piece of paper.
home.philosophyTitle: A map is not the journey
home.howSubtitle: We don't stop at reading. We stay with you until it clicks.
home.how1Body: Work through 503 lessons at your own pace — from the mathematics to the code, hands on.
home.how2Body: A built-in test on every lesson confirms your understanding on the spot — no false confidence.
home.how3Title: Deepen it in a live session
home.how3Body: Stuck on something? Work through it with an instructor in a live online meeting. You're never left stranded.
home.philosophyBody: No course makes you formidable on its own — only building does. So we don't hand you the material and walk away. You build lesson by lesson, confirm it with tests, and when you get stuck we work through it together in a live session. Walk the full path, and you don't just learn AI — you become the engineer the world is short of.
home.pathTitle: A linear path, twenty phases deep
home.pathSubtitle: Start where you are. Every phase builds on the last.
home.ctaSectionTitle: Become the engineer who builds AI
home.ctaSectionBody: Begin with the foundations, or jump straight to the phase that fits your level.
